info.name: CODE-CAL MISSIONS — monday export
info.description:
The export the importer reads. Generated from backend/monday_export.graphql and kept identical to it by tests/test_import_query.py — a collection that drifts from that file is how a board arrives with empty formula columns and no groups.

Set two collection variables: MONDAY_TOKEN (monday → Developers → My access tokens) and boardId.

Run the requests FROM HERE rather than pasting monday_export.graphql into a request of your own: that file holds both operations, and a request carrying both answers HTTP 200 with "operation name is required when multiple operations are defined". Postman's query box appends what is pasted instead of replacing it, and it scrolls — so a leftover second query is easy to miss. Each request here holds one operation.

Run "1 — page one". If the response's `cursor` is not null, run "2 — every page after it" with that cursor, again and again until it is. Put the responses in ONE file as a JSON array — [ {first}, {second}, … ] — and import that file.

Every request reports what came back in Test Results — "הגיעו 500 פריטים מתוך 687" — and requests 1 and 3 store the cursor they got, so request 3 needs nothing pasted into it: run it again and again until it says it was the last page.

The history pages by `page` and monday has no count for it, so request 2 walks itself: each Send asks for the page after the last and reports the running total ("עמוד 2: 10000 רשומות — סך הכל 20000"). When a page comes back short of the limit that is the whole log, and the walk resets. Save EVERY page's response — they all belong in the same JSON array.

Files: monday's asset links last about an hour, so export and import in one go if the attachments matter.

If boardId is empty the requests stop before they are sent, and the answer is checked for holding exactly the one board asked for. An empty or unresolved variable makes monday answer `boards(ids: [])` with the first 25 boards in the account — 200, no error, and a file that looks like an export of the wrong thing.

variable.description: monday personal API token. Keep it out of any collection you share.
The board's id, from its URL.
The cursor the previous response returned.
איזה עמוד של ההיסטוריה לבקש. הבקשה מקדמת אותו בעצמה ומחזירה אותו ל-1 כשהלוג נגמר.
סך הרשומות שנאספו עד כה בהליכה על העמודים. מתאפס בסוף.

request.description: Everything the board is: its name, its groups, its column definitions (where a formula's expression lives), and the first 500 items with their sub-items, conversations and assets.

exec: throw new Error('boardId ריק — מלא אותו ב-Variables של האוסף (Current value!). בלי זה מאנדיי מחזיר את כל הלוחות בחשבון, בלי שגיאה.');
pm.test('לוח אחד בתשובה, ולא כל החשבון', function () {
/* How many came, against how many there are. The count is a pm.test so it shows
in Test Results beside the others — a number to read, not an assertion. */
pm.test('הגיעו ' + got + ' פריטים מתוך ' + all + (page.cursor ? ' — יש עוד, הרץ בקשה 3' : ' — זה כל הלוח'), function () {});
/* The groups, and how many of them answered with a colour. A board is read
by its group headers before it is read at all, and `color` is the one
field whose absence is invisible in the response: the import then gives
the groups colours of its own and the board arrives recoloured, which
looks like a choice somebody made rather than a field nobody asked for. */
const colored = groups.filter(function (g) { return g && g.color; }).length;
pm.test('הגיעו ' + groups.length + ' קבוצות, ' + colored + ' מהן עם צבע' +
(groups.length && colored < groups.length ? ' — בדוק שהשאילתה מבקשת color' : ''), function () {});
/* The cursor is carried to request 3 on its own. Copying a 70-character string
by hand is where a character goes missing, and monday answers a cursor with
one character missing by refusing the whole request. */
console.log('cursor ריק — הלוח שלם בתשובה הזאת');

request.description: Everything the board is: its name, its groups, its column definitions (where a formula's expression lives), and the first 500 items with their sub-items, conversations and assets.

exec: throw new Error('boardId ריק — מלא אותו ב-Variables של האוסף (Current value!). בלי זה מאנדיי מחזיר את כל הלוחות בחשבון, בלי שגיאה.');
// page 1 unless a previous Send left the walk partway through
pm.test('לוח אחד בתשובה, ולא כל החשבון', function () {
/* monday has no count for the log — there is no activity_logs_count the way the
board has items_count — so how many entries there are is only knowable by
asking for a page, adding it up and asking for the next. A page short of the
limit is the end, and nothing before it says how far the end is. So the
request walks itself: each Send fetches the page after the last and carries
the running total, which is the number that was wanted all along. */
pm.test('עמוד ' + page + ': ' + logs.length + ' רשומות — סך הכל ' + total +
(more ? ' — יש עוד, הרץ שוב' : ' — זה כל הלוג'), function () {});
console.log('עמוד ' + page + ': מ-' + at(logs[logs.length - 1]) + ' עד ' + at(logs[0]));
console.log('סך הרשומות בלוג: ' + total + ', ב-' + page + ' עמודים. שמור כל תשובה לקובץ ואסוף אותן למערך אחד.');

request.description: Everything the board is: its name, its groups, its column definitions (where a formula's expression lives), and the first 500 items with their sub-items, conversations and assets.

exec: /* Each Send walks one page forward: the cursor this answer returns replaces the
one that fetched it, so running this request again fetches the page after —
until it says סוף. Nothing to copy between runs. */
pm.test('הגיעו ' + got + ' פריטים' + (page.cursor ? ' — יש עוד עמוד, הרץ שוב' : ' — זה העמוד האחרון'), function () {});
console.log('cursor עודכן — הרץ את הבקשה הזאת שוב');
console.log('אין עוד עמודים — אסוף את התשובות לקובץ אחד');
